title: InferA: A Smart Assistant for Cosmological Ensemble Data
problem: Analyzing large-scale scientific datasets (terabyte-scale) is hindered by volume, structural complexity, and need for domain expertise; existing automation tools (PandasAI) require full ingestion and lack structural awareness.
motivation: Scientific data analysis at scale requires both technical sophistication and domain knowledge; automation tools must handle terabyte datasets without loading everything into memory.
method: InferA: multi-agent system using LLMs to orchestrate analysis. Supervisor agent coordinates specialized agents for data retrieval and analysis phases; engages users interactively to clarify intent.
key_novelty: First multi-agent LLM system for scalable scientific data analysis; supervisor orchestration enables structured querying without full data ingestion.
contributions: Interactive user engagement for intent clarification
Structured data retrieval without full ingestion
Demonstration on HACC cosmology ensemble simulations
limitations: Abstract-only; lacks quantitative evaluation metrics, query latencies, or user study results
